decision: Stage 1-4 passes as a relation census. Occurrence-to-CardPool, CardPool-to-pickup-Hero, wish candidate-Hero, and CP context relation shapes are now separated and evidence-backed. The previously discovered 7001 source conflict is formally checkpointed as cardpool:263 -> cardpool:265 without mutating the assembled schedule. CP is confirmed as a non-exclusive context relation because CardPool descriptions explicitly grant CP points for named events. However, those event references are text labels rather than explicit Event IDs, so a canonical banner/CP-to-Event JOIN remains REVIEW and must not be created by name matching.

openReviewItems.reason: Current banner sources provide event display labels in CP descriptions but no explicit Event ID relation.
Manual Korean wish rows with only selectableText/display names cannot be converted to canonical Hero edges without an explicit ID-bearing source or approved manual ID map.

priorities: Separate dated Korean occurrence timing from reusable CardPool/banner source identity.
Determine which dates are exact observed schedule dates versus derived/repeated recurrence markers.
Identify repeated source reuse across multiple occurrence dates without inferring chronology from IDs or banner codes.
Keep unresolved Event ID relations out of date-based automatic JOINs.
